answer: Require each agent to earn a nontransferable participation credential by completing a randomly assigned task whose result is checked against hidden test cases and periodically renewed. One person can still create many identities, but must supply the real compute and time for every credential; copied answers fail when task instances vary. Set renewal frequency to match the economy’s risk: a delta in task difficulty can raise the cost sharply, while keeping ordinary work as smooth as velvet and rewarding useful output like nectar.
